# opnsense_interfaces_bridge (Resource)

Manages an OPNsense bridge interface and its spanning-tree options.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `members` (Set of String) Interfaces participating in the bridge.

### Optional

- `auto_edge` (Set of String) Ports for which automatic edge detection is disabled.
- `auto_point_to_point` (Set of String) Ports for which automatic point-to-point detection is disabled.
- `description` (String) Optional description.
- `edge` (Set of String) Edge ports.
- `enable_stp` (Boolean) Enable spanning-tree processing.
- `forward_delay` (Number) STP forwarding delay.
- `hold_count` (Number) STP transmit hold count.
- `link_local` (Boolean) Enable a link-local address on the bridge.
- `max_addresses` (Number) Bridge address-cache size.
- `max_age` (Number) STP configuration validity time.
- `point_to_point` (Set of String) Point-to-point ports.
- `private` (Set of String) Private ports.
- `protocol` (String) Spanning-tree protocol.
- `span` (String) Optional span port. It cannot also be a bridge member.
- `sticky` (Set of String) Sticky ports.
- `stp_members` (Set of String) Interfaces on which STP is enabled.
- `timeout` (Number) Bridge address-cache timeout in seconds.

### Read-Only

- `device` (String) Automatically allocated bridge device name.
- `id` (String) UUID of the bridge configuration.
